comment: Shared by klypix-mcp (src/app-lease.mjs) and the KLYPIX desktop app (electron/agentBridge). The app mirrors this file byte-for-byte through scripts/sync-bundled-mcp.mjs; change it only in klypix-mcp.

canonicalPath.rule: path.resolve; fs.realpathSync.native when the file exists; "/" -> "\"; lowercase. sha256 of the UTF-8 result, lowercase hex.
